text:
lyn: Heads up — prepping QSPARSE quant bundle (qsp-v1.2) for tonight's quiet window. Goal: canary slice -> staggered ramp. Need checksum verification, pin policy, RN blurb, and a rollback play.
rachel: Build artifacts uploaded to CDN: qsp-v1.2.tar.gz sha256=3b7f1c...9aaf. Packaging note: uses the compact matmul microkernel.
qa_ravi: Ran quick fuzzer on staging. Found one deterministic float rounding diff for a micro-batch edgecase (seq=8192, batch=1). We'll quantify mismatch rate.
lyn: What's our rollout acceptance? Suggest: model-mismatch < 0.5% with no memory spikes, and 99.9% success rate. If mismatch >1% or memory >80% of host for 5m => pause.
ops_lee: Agreed. I'll create a sticky pin to legacy-runtime:v12 for immediate fallback. TTL 3h while we're ramping.
deploybot: @ops_lee pin request accepted. Sticky-pin applied: legacy-runtime:v12 scope=org:prod, ttl=10800s, id=pin-9017.
infra_bot: Canary pool nodes must use kernel-compat=rollback-friendly flag. Current canary pool missing flag. Recommend `infractl patch pool canary --set kernel-compat=rollback-friendly`.
rachel: Patch added to infra PR; will merge on green.
docs_maya: Draft RN: "QSPARSE v1.2: experimental compact-matmul kernel. Canary rollout; fallback=legacy-runtime:v12. Watch mismatch-rate and memory use. Known issue: small rounding diffs on large seqs; see QA repro steps." Any additions?
lyn: Add line about perf expectations: p50 ~ equal, p95 shouldn't regress >12%.
qa_ravi: Smoke results after initial canary (0.2%): mismatch 0.14%, p95 +2.2%, memory stable. No OOMs.
deploybot: Initiating canary: slice=canary-qsp-20240315, bundle=qsp-v1.2, weight=0.2%. change_id=chg-7721.
qa_ravi: Note: one pod in eu-west-1 logged a checksum mismatch when pulling blob; it retried and recovered. I captured logs.
ops_lee: That's a blob fetch transient. I increased CDN retry backoff and nuked a flaky edge cache.
lyn: For rollback convenience, use `deploybot roll-to --slice canary-qsp-20240315 --target legacy-runtime:v12 --reason "blob/telemetry anomaly"` — ops & eng leads have exec rights.
rachel: Also ensure we tag the bundle with provenance tag `built-by=ci/5423` so we can trace.
infra_bot: Audit note: image signature verified: sig-id=sign-334. No expired certificates.
qa_ravi: At 23:25 I saw a 30s tail spike on one region (ap-south-1). p95 up ~9% for that minute, then normalized. No errors.
ops_lee: I routed new connections away from ap-south-1 for the next 10m while network team investigates.
lyn: Proceed to 3% at 23:40 if steady. Hold if any region shows >5% latency regress for 3 consecutive intervals.
deploybot: Increasing weight: slice=canary-qsp-20240315 -> 3%. change_id=chg-7722.
docs_maya: RN push ready: https://docs.internal/release/qsp-v1.2 — added troubleshooting + rollback commands.
qa_ravi: Running long-seq replication now (seq=8192, clients=15). Will report by 23:50.
lyn: Quick ops question: do we need to set `kernel-param=lockless-io` for canary nodes? That was in the bake notes for the matmul microkernel.
ops_lee: Good catch. I'll enable lockless-io flag for canary pool: `infractl flag set canary lockless-io=true` done.
rachel: One more small thing — CI flagged a packaging checksum mismatch on one runner earlier; I re-run and it's clean now. I will include a line in RN about checksum verification steps.
qa_ravi: 23:49 update: long-seq run finished. mismatch rate 0.18%, p95 +3.1% overall, no memory events.
lyn: Seems healthy. If no other alerts, schedule unpin to expire after TTL or we can manually remove at 02:00.
ops_lee: I'll keep the pin until 02:00 and then release unless we extend.
deploybot: Rollout status: slice=canary-qsp-20240315 weight=3% health=OK.
lyn: Thanks everyone — I'll post a short postmortem if anything crops up, otherwise we'll do the full rollout tomorrow morning in the daytime window. :pray:
